title.narrative: CSF03-20 YEAR 3 PAYMENT INTEGRAL PROTECTION OF HUMAN

description.narrative: The ‘Integral protection of human rights defenders in Africa’ project aims to strengthen the protection and recognition of human rights defenders in sub-Saharan Africa. The objectives are to undertake a combination of training and advocacy activities to enhance HRD engagement with UN and regional human rights mechanisms as well as improve the ability of these mechanisms to deliver on the ground for human rights defenders. The project will also contribute to enhancing the protection of human rights defenders at the national level, primarily through the enactment of specific legislation and the establishment of protection mechanisms. The key activities include the provision of accompanied advocacy for HRDs to engage with the ACHPR, the publication of human rights monitors, contributing to the establishment of an informal network of legal experts on HRD protection, organising trainings for HRDs on the application of the national HRD law, and small national campaigns to support the enactment of new HRD laws.
